name: crucible-vscode-extension
description: Agentic AI pair programmer: spec-first task planning, shadow-workspace patch review, and an inline chat controller — with a managed local runtime (no separate backend setup required).

crucible.backendBaseUrl.description: Leave default for the managed backend; set explicitly to attach to a dev backend (e.g. one started via start-backend.sh).

crucible.defaultMode.description: Default orchestration mode for submitted tasks.

crucible.pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval used while a task is running.

crucible.managedRuntime.enabled.description: Provision and spawn the Crucible runtime (backend, indexer, ripgrep, language servers) automatically per workspace. Disable to fall back to the pure dev flow (start-backend.sh + an explicit crucible.backendBaseUrl).

crucible.devSourcePath.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Absolute path to a Crucible checkout. When set, the managed runtime installs crucible-agentd EDITABLE from <path>/services/agentd-py instead of the released wheel, so backend edits are picked up on reload without rebuilding. Leave empty for normal installs. Changing it requires re-running Crucible: Run Setup (or deleting ~/.crucible/runtime/venv) to take effect.

crucible.policy.shell.description: Shell command policy for the execution agent's run_command tool. 'ask' surfaces an approval card for every command; 'allow_all' skips the gate.

crucible.policy.scope.description: Scope-extension policy for out-of-plan file writes. 'ask' pauses for approval; 'strict' auto-rejects; 'auto' silently approves and audit-logs.

crucible.performance.toolBatching.description: Enable multiple tool calls with dependency-aware command/network scheduling. Requires a backend restart.

crucible.performance.adaptiveReads.description: Enable larger bounded file reads and request-local result budgets. Requires a backend restart.

crucible.performance.compactContext.description: Compact tool catalog JSON and bound repository trees for new chats. Requires a backend restart.

crucible.webFetch.enabled.description: Enable native web fetch for public URLs. Downloads require approval and send the URL to the destination website. Requires a backend restart.

crucible.webSearch.enabled.description: Enable prototype native web search through Exa. Queries are sent externally and may be used for model training. Requires a backend restart.

crucible.memory.enabled.description: Enable the cross-session memory harness (compaction, recall, consolidation). Requires a managed restart to take effect.

crucible.localModels.description: Install local models for better code and memory search (about 1 GB download). Turning this off removes the optional packages. Restart the managed backend to apply.

crucible.memory.experimental.recall.description: Enable experimental scoped memory recall and tools for local testing. Requires a backend restart.

crucible.memory.experimental.curator.description: Enable experimental background memory curation for local testing. Requires experimental recall and a backend restart.

crucible.memory.experimental.compaction.description: Enable experimental capped evidence and sequential compaction folds for local testing. Requires a backend restart.

crucible.memory.experimental.storePath.description: Optional absolute path to a separate SQLite store for experimental durable memories. Empty uses the standard scoped store. Requires a backend restart.

enumDescriptions: Match the current VS Code colour theme
crucible.appearance.description: Colours for Crucible's panels. High-contrast VS Code themes always win.

crucible.accent.description: Accent colour for Crucible's panels (links, your messages, the send button).

scripts.prebuild: npm --prefix webview-ui install && npm --prefix webview-ui run build
